20260821122000_guard_channel_suggestion_.reason: Manual review approved an additive BEFORE INSERT trigger that serializes the exact versioned channel-suggestion ledger signature with stale claim release. 20260821122000_guard_channel_suggestion_.runtimeCompatibilityEvidence: Existing and new runtimes create versioned suggestion ledgers only while the exact publishing claim is active; all other max_action_ledger signatures bypass the trigger. The migration does not change stored columns or reads.
